notes.title: 🎬 SILICONE HEART TRAILER — WATCH NOW! 🎬
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We’re excited to share a big announcement — the Silicone Heart trailer is out now!

The main character is an outcast, thrown onto the scrap heap of history. After a tragic accident, a junkman ends up on a garbage planet inhabited by discarded robots. He’ll have to hide his identity and build his way to survival using whatever trash he can find.


What to expect:
 Tons of scrap waiting to be turned into something useful.
 Become a farmer and grow strange, otherworldly plants.
 Repair local robots and earn back their trust in humans.


And that’s just the beginning — even more surprises await.
🚀 Demo coming this summer.
🔥 Kickstarter campaign launching soon!

Watch and share your thoughts!
👇 [previewyoutube=sxmViprV-xg;full][/previewyoutube]

Drop a comment: 
➜ Which game mechanic caught your eye?
➜ What role do you think the mysterious substance will play?
➜ Do you believe the hero will complete his mission?

notes.title: Silicone Heart Big Trailer Announcement
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
We have great news for you. On May 1st we will show the first trailer for Silicone Heart — our farm about robots!

What's the plan: at 21:00  GMT+3, the trailer will open the Games from Russia festival. It will be shown on the main Steam page. At the same time, trailer will be released on the IGN.com website and on the Game Trailers (IGN) YouTube channel.

If you have your own blog and want to support Silicone Heart — publish an announcement. We value everyone's support. Press kit: https://drive.google.com/drive/u/0/folders/1ThCi3j9r7R0enR2MWXa-pYBMoh582XUW


Our social networks, subscribe to follow the development of the game.
